newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-INSIGHT - Australian All Resources seen bullish medium term.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-INSIGHT - Australian All Resources seen bullish medium term.

text.p: The Australian All Resources index (up 2.1 points at 1,379.7 at 2.30 p.m. (0430 GMT)) has bounced from lower levels and is now within a higher range between 1,365 to 1,415.
Traders are likely to trade this range but with the index overbought in the short term are seen wary of profit-taking.
In the short-term technical indicators for the index have turned higher but the ROC has lost some momenteum.
The index has exceeded the upper Bollinger Band which may entice profit-takers. With this in mind traders are seen hiking up trailing stops on long positions.
While the index targets higher levels in the medium term, conservative traders are not likely to dismiss the potential for some retracement. Fibonacci levels are 1,344, 1,332 and 1,320.
In the medium term the index remains in its overall bull channel since February 1995 and has broken resistance at 1,365.
Traders are seen welcoming this advance but as in the short term are still likely to have protective stops just below the current support levels.
Medium term technicals are bullish with only the 40 week moving average bearish. In the medium term, the index is not overbought and hence traders are likely to view dips as buying opportunities.
In the longer term the All Resources index remains bullish and traders are seen targeting next resistance at 1,415.
Longer term technicals have turned higher but are trading in the neutral zone. While this is a bullish sign the movement of these indicators do not suggest a run away movement higher this week.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own.)
